mainEntity.name: What should I look for when hiring a contractor for kitchen remodeling in Orange County?

acceptedAnswer.text: When hiring a contractor for kitchen remodeling in Orange County, prioritize experience, proper licensing, and insurance. Look for contractors with a strong portfolio of kitchen projects, positive client testimonials, and transparent communication. Verify their California contractor's license (CSLB) and ensure they carry liability insurance. It's also important to get a detailed, written contract outlining the scope of work, timeline, and payment schedule. Ask about warranties on workmanship and materials to ensure long-term satisfaction.
